notes: Approved AC intake questions (FR-06). Asked one at a time; every question accepts 'not sure'. Questions never ask the elder to reach, climb, open covers or read a hard-to-see label. Warning signs are screened by the hazard guard and hazards.json (Slice 2), not here.

questions.question: When did this problem start? A rough idea is fine.
Can you feel any air coming from the AC from where you are? It's fine to say you're not sure.
Can you easily see any letters or numbers lit up on the AC? Only if you can see them from where you are.
Does the AC beep or light up when you press the remote? It's fine to say you're not sure.
